field_updates.detail: Fig. 1 "Typical Forward Characteristics", TA = 25 C curve (third from left; order 125/75/25/-25 C), typical forward curve, vector-extracted read points (IF, VF): (0.0001 A, 0.2056 V), (0.0002 A, 0.2231 V), (0.0005 A, 0.2462 V), (0.001 A, 0.2644 V), (0.002 A, 0.2838 V), (0.005 A, 0.3157 V), (0.01 A, 0.3471 V), (0.02 A, 0.3902 V), (0.05 A, 0.4807 V), (0.1 A, 0.5825 V); residuals mV: [3.8, 2.0, -0.9, -2.9, -4.5, -3.9, -1.4, 3.0, 9.8, -5.0] (rms 4.4, max 9.8) Method: Least-squares fit of VF = N*Vt*ln(IF/IS+1) + IF*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt=25.69 mV at 25 C, over 0.1 mA to 100 mA (10 points, the whole plotted 25 C curve). Points read from the PDF vector path of the curve (not a raster), axis calibrated to the plot frame/decade grid lines. Curve drawn as filled outline; mean of outline crossings. Grid lines inside each decade are irregular in this figure, so calibration uses the evenly spaced decade lines (0.1/1/10/100 mA). The figure is shared by BAT42W and BAT43W and is not labelled per part; it is consistent with both (e.g. 0.284 V@2 mA within BAT43W 0.26-0.33 V; 0.347 V@10 mA under BAT42W max 0.40 V).
field_updates.scope: Diodes Incorporated BAT42W; IS for the OHMNI simulation model (fit to the datasheet's own data); not a guaranteed limit

field_updates.detail: "500 nA VR = 25V" Method: Test voltage of IR_ref.

field_updates.detail: Fig. 2 "Typical Reverse Characteristics" at VR = 25 V: 0.136 uA (25 C), 4.86 uA (75 C), 106.8 uA (125 C) Method: Least-squares slope of ln IR vs T at VR=25 V over 25-125 C (pairwise 0.0715 for 25-75 C, 0.0618 for 75-125 C). Cross-check from table maxima "500 nA VR = 25V" and "100 uA VR = 25V, TJ = +100C": ln(200)/75 = 0.0706 /K. Both are at/above the class aT range max 0.07. Leakage in Fig. 2 also rises ~3.4x from 5 V to 30 V at 25 C, which the linear-in-V template does not capture.
field_updates.scope: Diodes Incorporated BAT42W; aT for the OHMNI simulation model (fit to the datasheet's own data); not a guaranteed limit
